_about: Daily social drops (owner, 16 Oct 2026: 'lock all these plans ... dont forget the cover images'). One clip a day at 12:30 Lagos on X + Instagram (scheduled in Buffer) and Telegram (.github/workflows/promo-drop.yml reads this file). Feature posts at 19:00 Lagos on X + Telegram. Every Reel has its own cover (public/promo/covers). Rules: no 'free', no win promises, 18+, no em dashes, catchy first line. Buffer cannot send a custom cover image, so the Instagram file (igVideo) ends with the cover as a 0.6s still and the Reel cover is set with metadata.thumbnailOffset = coverMs.
